title: Drop gossipsub and libp2p from transit
description: The block store is now external (LMDB/Kubo), so the in-process libp2p swarm (gossipsub + Kademlia + yamux + noise) only served to propagate tip advertisements. With that function gone, libp2p is pure overhead and carries unpatched CVEs (GHSA-xqmp-fxgv-xvq5, GHSA-gc42-3jg7-rxr2, GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338). Remove the entire gossip module, xcid_client (client side only), all gossip wiring from main.rs, and the libp2p dep.
